answer: A ripple toll: each identity seeds one ripple that must cross a frozen tundra of escrow hops to reach the zenith, each hop tripling the next identity's stake. Fake k locks 4 times 3 to the power k minus 1: 10 fakes lock 118,096, 100 fakes lock more than 10 to the 47th. The bond thaws one hop per epoch; a replayed ripple fails, since each hop hash commits to one identity alone.
